description: This file is a Yocto build include (.inc) file configuring the Linux kernel for Raspberry Pi within a Yocto build environment. It contains variable definitions, build instructions, kernel configuration functions, and conditional build steps tailored for Raspberry Pi models, enabling customization of kernel features and deployment specifics.

methods.name: kernel_configure_variable
methods.description: Sets or unsets a kernel configuration option in the build process, writing to the .config file based on parameters.

methods.name: config_setup
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration by copying existing configs when necessary, enabling further configuration adjustments.

methods.name: do_configure_prepend
methods.description: Prepares the kernel configuration before the main build, enabling conditional feature inclusion based on machine features.

methods.name: do_compile_append_kirkstone
methods.description: Build step for compiling device tree blobs (dtbs) when targeting 64-bit sites.

methods.name: do_compile_append_dunfell
methods.description: Build step for compiling device tree blobs (dtbs) with specific compiler options for the 'dunfell' machine series.

methods.name: do_deploy_append_dunfell
methods.description: Deployment step that writes the kernel command line configuration to the boot directory, conditionally including patching for specific hardware features.
